instruction: I want to change the VLC progress slider colors to all black tones for a darker theme. How can I configure custom slider colors in VLC preferences?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing VLC slider colors to black/dark tones. The evaluator checks the VLC config file for qt-slider-colours setting, verifying all color values are blackish (RGB values < 100). This uses the existing check_qt_slider_colours metric function with type 'blackish'.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement: changing VLC slider colors to black tones
Getter (get_vlc_config) correctly extracts the VLC config file (vlcrc) from the appropriate OS-specific path
Metric (check_qt_slider_colours) correctly parses the qt-slider-colours setting and validates all RGB values are < 100 (blackish threshold)
Complete coverage: All colors in the slider string are checked, not just some
Postconfig appropriately kills and relaunches VLC to ensure config file is written to disk
The 'blackish' type with threshold of 100 (out of 255) is semantically reasonable for dark/black tones (~39% brightness)
Data flow is correct: config file path -> metric receives path and rule dict -> parses and validates colors
